pair_created_with_salt_occurred.meaning: a pair for the launched token was created by createPair using a salt that includes _launchpadLp and _launchpadFeeDistributor

pairfor_computed_from_token0_token1_hash.meaning: pairFor computes the pair address from token0, token1, and uniV2InitCodeHash

end_rewards_completed.meaning: endRewards successfully terminates the rewards accrual process for the launched token (does not revert)

rewards_accrual_terminated.meaning: the rewards accrual process for the launched token is terminated

assumptions: endRewards is invoked for a launched token whose pair was created by createPair (end_rewards_called, end_rewards_calls_distributor).
The report does not state any caller authorization for endRewards; the plan does not encode one.

unresolved.description: Report does not specify the exact salt formula or the full pairFor input set beyond token0, token1, uniV2InitCodeHash, so the address-mismatch relation cannot be encoded numerically; only the qualitative completion/termination obligation is formalized.

limitations: The selected impact is formalized as a progress/liveness obligation: under the stated pair-creation and pairFor conditions, endRewards must complete and terminate rewards accrual.
The address-mismatch root cause and the revert are not encoded as P; they are the reported violation mechanism, not preconditions.
Other listed impacts (end_rewards_reverts, end_rewards_dos, rewards_management_disrupted) are not formalized by this plan.
